expect: 625 to 47 ppm: 578 ppm removed; NMP-processed at 100 °C: 87 ppm, so the water-based cathode ends lower (p8.L53-59)
question: How much residual moisture did the water-processed NMC532 cathode lose between 20 °C and drying at 120 °C, and how does its final value compare with the NMP-processed cathode dried at 100 °C?
rendered:
According to the document, the residual moisture in the water-processed NMC 532 cathode was 625 ppm at 20 °C. After drying at 110-120 °C, the residual moisture was 47 ppm.

The residual moisture in the NMP-processed NMC 532 cathode was 87 ppm after drying at 100 °C under vacuum for 2 h.

So, the water-processed NMC 532 cathode lost 578 ppm (625 - 47) of residual moisture between 20 °C and drying at 120 °C.
